hamilton-principle-classical-2d9f46c3.title: Hamilton’s Principle (Classical Action)
hamilton-principle-classical-2d9f46c3.interpretation: Postulates that the true physical trajectory of a system is a stationary point of the action functional within configuration space.
hamilton-principle-classical-2d9f46c3.symmetry_origin: The variational foundation of dynamical laws, where paths are determined by global extremization rather than local forces.
hamilton-principle-classical-2d9f46c3.limits_and_boundary: Anchors the derivation of the Euler-Lagrange equations for discrete mechanical systems.

dimensionless-dark-energy-density-ident-.title: Dark Energy Density Parameter
dimensionless-dark-energy-density-ident-.interpretation: Defines the fractional contribution of dark energy to the total energy density of the universe relative to the critical density required for geometric flatness.
dimensionless-dark-energy-density-ident-.symmetry_origin: The normalization of the Friedmann equation by the square of the Hubble parameter.
dimensionless-dark-energy-density-ident-.limits_and_boundary: Current measurements indicate $\Omega_\Lambda \approx 0.68$, identifying dark energy as the dominant constituent of the modern 4D manifold.

quines-ontological-criterion-ident-15bc9.title: Quine's Ontological Criterion
quines-ontological-criterion-ident-15bc9.interpretation: Asserts that a theory is ontologically committed to those entities that must fall within the range of its bound variables for the theory's statements to be true.
quines-ontological-criterion-ident-15bc9.symmetry_origin: The logical requirement of existential quantification within a formal physical language.
quines-ontological-criterion-ident-15bc9.limits_and_boundary: Distinguishes between 'Instrumental' entities used for calculation and 'Real' entities that are essential for the theory's truth-value.
